spec.claim_summary: Bitcoin daily breakout strategy buys a new 20-day high after at least three sessions since the prior marker and exits within a few days with a stop below the trigger.
assumptions: Asset BTC mapped to Binance spot BTCUSDT.
Timeframe 1d chosen from page chart; not stated in claim text.
Direction long per Buy entry wording.
Entry evaluated on bar closes with fill at next open approximates Buy entry placed on the next day at the watermark.
Prior 20-day watermark referenced excluding current bar via highest_high offset 1; close beyond it defines new high.
3-session filter encoded as no breakout close in prior 3 bars: close[1] <= watermark[2] AND close[2] <= watermark[3] AND close[3] <= watermark[4].
Holding period set to 4 bars as representative value within stated 2-6 interval range.
Stop approximated as fixed 3% because schema allows only fixed-pct or ATR stops.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim triggers long on a new 20-day high OR a new 20-day low; schema entry is AND-only with single direction so only the high-breakout long side is tested and the low-breakout long side is omitted.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: true stop is price-based below the latest triggering high/low watermark varying per trade and cannot be expressed as fixed-pct; fixed 3% is an approximation for testability.

evidence.quote: The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker.
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
OHLCV historical data for Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.
Buy entry is placed on the next day at the previous 20 day high/low watermark
Stop entries for failed trades are placed below the latest high/low that triggered the signal
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals

audit_majors: entry: Claim triggers Buy on new 20-day high OR new 20-day low; spec tests only high-breakout longs and omits the low-breakout long leg admitted as NOT EXPRESSIBLE, removing half the claimed signals.

stop_loss_pct: Claim stop is price-based below the latest triggering high/low watermark varying per trade; spec invents fixed 3% stop (candidates 1/2/3/5%) not in claim, which differs from watermark distance.
